record.paperId: Old_Questions/Direct_2014-2018/7.Jr. Grade of MES 2015 Computer Science & Engineering Paper II.pdf
record.question: Reflection of a point about x-axis, followed by a counter-clockwise rotation of 90º, is equivalent to reflection about the line.
record.explanation: Reflection about the x-axis maps (x,y)->(x,-y); a subsequent counter-clockwise 90 deg rotation maps (u,v)->(-v,u), so the composite sends (x,y)->(x,-y)->(y,x), i.e. matrix [[0,1],[1,0]], which is exactly reflection in the line y = x, so the option 'y = x' is chosen. Source caveat: on printed page 5 of the PDF, only option (a) 'x = - y' is actually printed; the text layer and a 200-dpi render of the page show options (b), (c) and (d) completely blank (a garbled equation fragment sits in the left margin), so the bank's reconstructions 'y = x', 'y = -x', 'x = y' could not be verified against the paper, and 'y = x' and 'x = y' denote the same line, leaving a small residual ambiguity in picking the intended option.
